name: Pokémon Yellow
notes: Base-game pack. Encounter pools generated from PokéAPI data, merged to location level across sub-areas, encounter methods, and the paired versions (in-game trades and raid/event distributions excluded); area order is estimated from encounter levels and is approximate. Species + levels only; moves/abilities/items intentionally left empty (Gen I has no abilities/held items). Yellow gym teams differ from Red/Blue (e.g. Lt. Surge has only a Lv 28 Raichu; Koga uses Venonat x3 + Venomoth; Sabrina uses Abra/Kadabra/Alakazam all Lv 50); the Elite Four teams are unchanged from Red/Blue. Champion Blue's team varies by how his Eevee evolved, which depends on the outcomes of the earlier rival battles: this pack uses the Jolteon variant (win both the Professor Oak's Lab and Route 22 battles), ace Jolteon Lv 65. The Flareon and Vaporeon variants swap the Lv 61/63 filler members (Magneton/Cloyster/Ninetales) and the ace accordingly.
